paper.title: Center-of-Mass Interpretation of Evolution Strategies
paper.description_en: Interprets the mean-centered ES step geometrically as a scaled shift between the sampled centroid and reward-weighted center of mass. Motivated by ES language-model fine-tuning; theoretical analysis, not a new empirically validated LM training method. No backpropagation in the analyzed ES step; no trained modules reported.
paper.description_zh: 将均值中心化ES更新解释为采样质心与奖励加权重心之间的缩放位移，以语言模型ES微调为动机。属于理论解释，未提供新的语言模型训练实证。所分析ES步骤无需反传；未报告实际训练模块。
